name: Default Nutritional Scoring Criteria (2023 Revision)
description: Baseline cut-offs and weights informed by Nutri-Score 2023, WHO, FSSAI, and UK FSA front-of-pack traffic-light thresholds.

sugars.name: Sugars
sugars.source: UK FSA / WHO Cut-off (<=5g low/green, >22.5g high/red)

sodium.name: Sodium
sodium.source: UK FSA / FSSAI (<=120mg low/green, >600mg high/red [~1.5g salt])

ingredient_quality.name: Ingredient Quality
ingredient_quality.source: Project-defined: Whole grains, sugar hierarchy order, NOVA processing level

additives.name: Additive Profile
